europe_now.title: Swedish General Election Remains Undecided
europe_now.summary: Sweden's general election remains extremely close with the center-left bloc holding a razor-thin lead as vote counting continues. Early exit polls and results show a tight race following a late right-wing surge and a hard night for the far right.

europe_now.title: Russian Drone Strike Hits Passenger Train Near Polish Border
europe_now.summary: A Russian drone struck a passenger train traveling the Kyiv-Warsaw route close to the Ukrainian border with Poland. The attack occurred shortly after European officials and former British Prime Minister Boris Johnson departed the station, drawing swift condemnation from regional leaders.
